_readme: Data for the retail comparison 'Bromic Platinum And Tungsten vs Heatstrip' (Australia), built by reports/retail/vs-heatstrip/build.js. Owner, 23 Nov 2026: "create a bromic platinum and bromic tungsten v/s heatstrip too.....use the attached data for heatstrip comparison". The attached data is the owner's campaign page 'Measured warmth' (campaign-page_measured-warmth.html, TESTS and SPEC tables, claim register) and its HANDOVER.md, 20 Oct 2026. Tests and Heatstrip specifications are copied from it as data; the [verify] and [Rev 2] flags in its SPEC table are kept here as [[VERIFY]] notes. Tungsten Series II facts come from data/product-facts.json and data/product-marketing/tungsten-electric-series-ii.json. No Tungsten test against Heatstrip exists: Tungsten is compared on published specifications only and no performance claim is made for it. Sources are kept here and in reports/retail/vs-heatstrip/sources.json and are not printed.
title: Bromic Platinum And Tungsten vs Heatstrip

gates.rule: The comparative test figures (warm-zone areas, temperature rise) go public only after Infrascan Rev 2 and Australian counsel have cleared them.

Low-clearance recess lines (worry-free recessing, the 180 mm cavity) go public only once each kit's Australian electrical approval is on file and the 180 mm Australian figure is confirmed (US pages say 10 in). "Safely" is not used (owner: "worry-free").

Claim register: 'warms up faster' is on hold; only 'faster in the first 5 minutes', and only after Rev 2 (Heatstrip Enhance 3200W out-heats Platinum 3400W between 5 and 10 min; the Classic 2400W data is suspect).
Claim register: never quote a percentage from the Infrascan PDFs (they divide by Bromic's figure). Publish raw m² and percentages computed here from them.

test.method: Single unit of each model, as purchased, mounted 2.0 m above a 4 x 4 m target. Areas where the target sat 2, 4 and 6 °C above ambient after 35 minutes. Quarter footprint measured with the heater at the corner; full areas are ellipses, pi x a x b. Commissioned by Bromic, using Bromic's test method.

platinum.recess: Standard recess kit, glass face flush with the ceiling
platinum.low_clearance: Low-clearance recess kit with a built-in cooling fan, ceiling cavity from 180 mm, for 2300, 3400 and 4500W

tungsten._note: Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric Series II: Select and Coastal launched October 2026; Classic follows January 2027 (hard rule 7). US documents; Australian range, supply and listings are open.
tungsten.outputs: 2, 3, 4 and 6 kW on Select; 4 and 6 kW on Coastal
tungsten.dual_elements: Dual elements on 4 and 6 kW, dimmable in 1% steps with the Affinity Smart-Heat Dimmer
tungsten.finishes: Select: black, white or graphite (graphite on 4 and 6 kW), front included. Coastal: black or white
tungsten.fronts: Diamond Pattern as standard; oval and triangle sold separately (Select)
tungsten.coastal: Coastal: a high-temperature corrosion-resistant coating over 316 marine-grade stainless steel; marine-grade recess kit; not for marine craft
tungsten.coastal_verify: [[VERIFY: Coastal body material (316 per the Lookbook and launch deck) and the coating's name — Product team]]
tungsten.size_verify: [[VERIFY: which outputs share each body length; depth stays off customer copy until measured the same way — Product team]]
tungsten.kg: 5.9 (2 and 4 kW), 6.8 (3 and 6 kW), from 13 and 15 lb in the US manuals
tungsten.mounting: Ceiling, pitched ceiling 3/12 to 12/12 (14 to 45°) with the adaptor, wall, extended wall, single post, recessed
tungsten.tilt_verify: [[VERIFY: 45° tilt on 4 and 6 kW; the Series II manual gives 30° — Product team]]
tungsten.low_clearance: Dual fan-ventilated low-clearance recess kit, recess box supplied with the kit; one kit for Select and Coastal (marine-grade on Coastal)
tungsten.cavity: 190.5 mm (7.5 in) minimum cavity, US recess kit manual
tungsten.cavity_verify: [[VERIFY: Series II recess kit cavity depth in Australia, no fire-rated lining under its listing, and continuous-use guidance — Product team]]
tungsten.warranty: 3 years on the heater, 7 years on the elements
tungsten.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat Dimmer as standard, On/Off where dimming is not wanted, and a manual wall switch (sold separately)
